In a Reverse-Graft Loop (⬅), the word goes IN FRONT of LAND: UP + LAND = Upland. You have to resist the forward trap SLIDE (LAND + SLIDE = Landslide)!
In a Reverse-Graft Loop (⬅), the word goes IN FRONT of UP: LINE + UP = Lineup. You have to resist the forward trap SIDE (UP + SIDE = Upside)!
